approval.geometryChange: SafeSave C and CARTMOD F approved

options.name: Archive
options.description: Two offset memory cartridges. A tangible collection of saved progress; neither a cloud nor a backup-success claim.

options.name: Checkpoint
options.description: A cartridge with an integrated bookmark. Warm, recognisable and focused on returning to your progress.

options.name: Assembly
options.description: Two interlocking components with the silhouette of a cartridge. A purposeful manufactured mark, without tools or a generic settings gear.

options.name: Workshop
options.description: A cartridge with two precision adjustment rails. Explicitly communicates configuration and preparation, not gameplay.

options.name: Patch
options.description: One complete custom interlocking patch silhouette, with an inset seam to suggest fitting new content. No settings rails or shield.

options.name: Workbench
options.description: An angled precision spanner above a short bench line. Directly evokes a game workshop with a strong simple silhouette.

options.name: CM maker's mark
options.description: A custom C and M pair, drawn as one coherent compact maker's stamp. Abstract brand identity rather than literal settings icon.

wordmarks: Existing B2 path lettering unchanged for comparison; optional heavier stroke in specimen only, not a new master.
